top_violation_types.title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three children's files were missing healthcare professional statements.

top_violation_types.title: Handwashing Procedures (26 TAC §746.3419)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection, handwashing procedures were not observed for a caregiver who failed to wash their hands and the hands of an infant following a diaper change.

top_violation_types.title: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves (26 TAC §746.3505(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver did not wash hands after disposing of gloves during diapering procedures.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: All outdoor equipment observed have exposed pinch, crush, or shear points, on or underneath it. It was observed nails and bolts out of the wood and plastic parts.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers had expired CPR and Fist Aid certification.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's play structures did not have the correct depth of loose fill. The play structures need six inches of loose fill.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger (26 TAC §746.501(a)(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies did not have information on safe sleep.
